verdict.rationale: Figma's REST API supports webhooks so you can listen for events (file updates, comments, etc.), and the Plugin API lets code run on certain invocations, but there is no native rules engine where a user declaratively defines 'on event X, do action Y' entirely within Figma — webhooks require external code to actually perform actions. missing for 10: a first-party automation/rules builder, evidence of trigger-action chains executing without custom external glue code, and any AI-native example of defining such rules.
